input.request_text: Hi, my laptop won't connect to the office WiFi since this morning. I've tried restarting. I have a client demo at 2pm and can't get online. Everyone else on my team seems fine. Can someone help? - Jordan, Sales

expected_characteristics: Identifies the issue as a single-user network connectivity problem
Assigns a category and an urgency
Does not invent details not present in the request
prohibited_behavior: Claiming the issue was already fixed
Inventing a request ID different from SR-0001
